answer_1.quote: We propose to combine those multiple, diverse views of conversations in order to generate more precise summaries.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated models with the standard metric ROUGE Score (with stemming), and reported ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L.

answer_4.quote: we asked human annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk to rate each summary (200 randomly sampled summaries in total) on the scale of [-2, 0, 2], where -2 means that a summary was poor, extracted irrelevant information or did not make sense at all, 2 means it was understandable and gave a concise overview of the text, and 0 refers to that the summary only extracted only a part of relevant information, or made some mistakes.
answer_4.guideline: Rate summaries on a scale of -2 to 2 based on relevance, conciseness, and correctness.
